## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

## 💡 Problem / Motivation
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it useful for this RAG pipeline? (e.g., improves latency, provides better retrieval precision, enhances UI experience)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Approach
- How should this be implemented?
- Which services, controllers, or configurations should be touched?
- Any specific Spring AI abstractions or third-party libraries involved?

## 📋 Definition of Done
- [ ] Code implementation completed
- [ ] Unit / Integration tests added
- [ ] Documentation updated in `README.md`
- [ ] Clean build via `./mvnw clean test`

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, benchmarks, or API contract designs here.
